_description: All 720 barangays of the province of Albay, Philippines, with PSA geographic codes and 2015/2020 census population.

population.name: PSA 2015 & 2020 Census of Population and Housing, per barangay

_notes: `name` is the common/display name; `official_name` is the PSGC official name.
`is_poblacion` marks the población — the barangay forming the population centre/urban core of its LGU.
The two sources were cross-checked independently and agree on all 720 barangays and their per-LGU counts.
